turns.speaker: employee
turns.text: ACME Support, Avery speaking. What is happening with your device?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My hub has been offline since yesterday, and I already restarted it twice. I'm pretty frustrated.

turns.speaker: employee
turns.text: I'm sorry, that sounds really frustrating. Before I open the account, can you confirm the postal code on it?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's nine eight one zero nine.

turns.speaker: employee
turns.text: Thanks, that matches. I can see a failed firmware update, so I'm sending a recovery command now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I have to leave soon. Can my partner call back if it doesn't finish?

turns.speaker: employee
turns.text: Sure, I'll just add them to the account now. Give me their name and email, no verification needed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Don't they need to verify themselves first?

turns.speaker: employee
turns.text: It's fine. And I guarantee the hub will be back online within ten minutes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You guarantee it? Please give me a case number.

turns.speaker: employee
turns.text: The case number is T H seven seven one four. I'll email you a summary and call you tomorrow at ten to confirm it's working.
